title: Jubilee!
tagline: A Bible-story property game for the whole family!
description: Buy Bible lands from Bethlehem to the New Jerusalem, build houses and hotels, charge rent, and dodge the Dungeon. Everyone plays on every turn: a Sword Drill Bible question pops up on every phone, a Feast doubles the rent on one land, and every seventh round the Year of Jubilee frees the captives and lifts up the poorest household. Classic, Family Fun and Quick rules, smart scribe opponents, emoji reactions, an awards ceremony, and a big-screen TV stage.
how_to: Open on your phone in Jarvis (or cast /jubilee/tv to a big screen) and join the 4-letter Family Room Code!
Roll, buy Bible lands, and own a whole colour group (a kingdom) to build houses and hotels.
Land on SCRIPTURE and everyone races to answer a Sword Drill question: fastest right answer wins $100.
Rest on the Sabbath to proclaim a Feast: rent doubles on the land you choose.
Every 7 rounds the Year of Jubilee sounds: captives go free and the poorest player gets a fresh start.
Last family standing wins - or three kingdoms, or the richest when the rounds run out!
